About the company

Components you can rely on, straight from the factory.

Airflow Innovations is a family-run manufacturer of HVAC air distribution components in Lahore. Since 2004 we have designed and produced diffusers, dampers and disk valves in our own factory.

Contractors, MEP consultants and fit-out companies across Pakistan work with us for consistent quality, custom sizing and factory-direct pricing, from single replacement units to full building-scale orders.
